description: Ponctualité par type de train et par moment - Stiptheid per type trein en per moment - Monthly national punctuality per train type and moment is a dataset listed in transportdata.be, a national access point for transport data, published or maintained by Infrabel. Monthly punctuality per train type (L, S, P, IC) and per moment of the day (peak hours, off-peak hours, weekend). Coverage: Belgium (see the dataset page for the exact area). The portal lists 1 resource in CSV. The data standards named are other. The national access point types are MMTIS. The portal shows 2024-12-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support mobility and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-transportdata-be-national-access-point.
